headline: Moving the chains right down the field!
what_happened: On a third down, which is the offense's third and final try to gain enough ground, T.Warren ran up the middle for 3 yards to get a fresh set of downs.
why_it_matters: Getting those yards keeps the drive alive and bumps the Colts' chances of winning up by 2 percentage points.
pop_culture: Taylor Swift is watching from the suite, just like when her vintage Chiefs tank top sold out.
